items.title: Dick Hyman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I was very touched last year when James Williams and what’s his name Childs, the other pianist... They called me up together and wished me a happy birthday

ctx.x: Now that I’ve reached the mature age of 74. Ruby’s [Braff] birthday and mine are very close you know, and a few people are, I was very touched last year when James Williams and what’s his name Childs, the other pianist.
